message:
Running command: python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
from PIL import Image
img=Image.new('RGB',(2,2),(255,0,0))
img.save('/tmp/base.jpg','JPEG',subsampling=0,quality=90)
orig=bytearray(Path('/tmp/base.jpg').read_bytes())
idx=orig.find(b'\xff\xc0')
cs=idx+2+2+1+2+2+1
for samp in [0x21,0x22,0x31,0x12,0x13,0x14,0x41,0x24]:
    data=bytearray(orig)
    data[cs+1]=samp
    data[cs+4]=samp
    p='/tmp/t.jpg'
    Path(p).write_bytes(data)
    print('samp',hex(samp), end=' ')
    import subprocess, os
    r=subprocess.run(['/tmp/jpeg_poc',p],capture_output=True,text=True)
    print('rc',r.returncode,'stderr',r.stderr.splitlines()[:2])
PY
